summary.text: Rob Epstein is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 23, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Bill Fincher.
A retired software professional who lives in Cherokee County, he says he is running on affordable healthcare, government transparency and housing costs.

paragraphs.text: Epstein earned a high school diploma from Sprayberry High School and a bachelor's degree from Georgia State University in 1998, and he also attended Shorter University and Kennesaw State University.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he spent his professional career building enterprise-level web applications and, for the past 20 years, helping individuals build careers.
Epstein said in the survey that his key messages are making healthcare more affordable, making government more transparent and accountable, and making housing more affordable.
He said he is running to listen to and serve every resident of the district across Cherokee County regardless of beliefs and background.
